entries.zh: 阐明、开示（字头疑为 闡/閘，与西语 alabar『称赞』不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: to explain, elucidate (head-character uncertain: 闡/閘; does not match Sp. alabar 'to praise'; gloss doubtful)
entries.notes: 四栏语义不合：L=alabar，H 带[疑:闡/閘]，R 栏 Gegen. sien 亦异常，语义无法定夺，暂按汉字本义释义

entries.en: to praise, commend
to praise, extol (by recounting someone's virtues)
to call, address (by title); to praise and hold in high esteem
entries.notes: L 作『称赞并器重』而 H 稱呼本义为称呼，两栏义有出入，释义并取

entries.en: to praise and admire, commend with envy
to rejoice, be delighted; to praise gladly
to admire and envy, delight in
to raise up; to commend, extol
entries.notes: R 栏 gui 与汉字 舉 的官话读音不合，疑转写讹误，据 L/H/M 定释义

entries.en: to raise up and commend worthy men (trailing L abbreviation 'D r s.' unresolved)
entries.notes: L 缩写 D r s. 疑为 Dios『神』，与汉字 举贤人 义不合，R 栏 xin 亦异常，释义据 H/M

entries.en: to recommend, put forward; to praise, magnify

entries.zh: 衍伸、散布（字头疑为 衍/衎，与西语 alabarse『自夸』不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: to spread, extend; (衎) to be glad — head-character uncertain, does not match Sp. alabarse 'to praise oneself'; gloss doubtful
entries.notes: 字头带[疑:衍/衎]，与 L 义不合，语义无法定夺

entries.en: to show off, boast; boastfulness

entries.zh: 逞头皮、厚脸皮（恬不知耻）
entries.en: to be brazen, impudent; to have a thick skin
entries.notes: 西语 onstble 拼写残讹未能展开，释义依汉字 逞头皮 与对音

entries.zh: 逞力、逞强使力（夸示力气）
entries.en: to boast of one's strength, show off one's might

entries.zh: 逞勇、逞能好勇（夸示勇武）
entries.en: to boast of being brave, vaunt one's valor

entries.zh: 逞气、赌气逞强（负气争胜）
entries.en: to vent one's spite, insist stubbornly on having one's own way (L garbled 'Podolipuede', cf. poder/puede 'to boast one can')
entries.notes: 西语 Podolipuede 拼写残讹，疑为 poder…puede，释义依汉字 逞气 与对音

entries.zh: 逞豪杰、逞英雄（自夸豪强、事事要占先）
entries.en: to boast of being mighty; to play the hero and get one's own way
to boast; to grow arrogant, haughty

entries.zh: 讨着就无（夸称富有，一讨便推说没有）
entries.en: 'ask, and there is nothing': to boast of being rich yet give nothing when asked
to be praised and admired by all
entries.notes: 西语 seyendo d'acierta 拼写残讹未能确解，释义依汉字 通称羡 与对音
